name: page-source-rest
title: Page Source REST
description: PageSource adapters for plain query-param paging: page and size (`?page=2&size=25`, 0- or 1-based) and limit and offset (`?offset=20&limit=20`).
docs: `pagedSource({ key, getId, request, base, pageParam, sizeParam, read, total })` sends `?page=2&size=25` (1-based unless `base: 0`); `offsetSource({ offsetParam, limitParam })` turns the page into `?offset=20&limit=20`. `request(call)` receives `{ params, query, request, signal }`: fetch your endpoint with `call.query` and `call.signal`. By default the response is `{ items, total?, hasMore? }`; `read(raw, request)` maps another. `total: "estimate" | "none"` switches the table to previous and next. Each takes `params: (filter) => …` for a serializer's output, `sortStyle` and `maxPageSize`; return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError`.
